claim_ceiling: Exact first-order-coupling, equal-spin, slow-rotation reparameterization at fixed Symtropy (R_H,Omega_H). chi=a/mu as in Ma-Lu Eq. 10. mu/R_H^2 is converted background MP parameter, not corrected ADM mass. No H5/H6 angular-diagonal metric match or finite-coupling solution is claimed.

parameter_interpretation.mu_over_R_H2: Converted background Myers-Perry mass parameter only; not the corrected ADM mass.
parameter_interpretation.physical_ADM_mass: Must be independently extracted from the asymptotic 1/R^2 coefficient of the fully transformed metric, including the H1 correction and the selected ensemble.
parameter_interpretation.ma_lu_parameter_ensemble: The perturbative construction holds the background MP parameters/horizon data fixed; the fixed-Symtropy (R_H,Omega_H) map is a reparameterization and must not be mistaken for the thermodynamic fixed-(T,Omega) or fixed-charge ensembles.
